thanks: Thanks! Your suggestion is in the list as "proposed".
coversMissing: {n} suggestion(s) without a cover. The module looks for them on its own, a few at a time; the button starts the search right now.
coversNoKeyHint: {n} suggestion(s) without a cover, but no RAWG key is saved: enter it in [Settings](/admin/settings).
coversLast: Last automatic search: {date} (UTC) — {found} found, {none} with no result.
coversDeniedHint: RAWG refuses the saved key: check it in [Settings](/admin/settings). The search resumes in 24 hours, or when you click the button.
coversNoKey: No RAWG key: enter it in [Settings](/admin/settings), then run the search again.
coversDenied: RAWG refuses the key (wrong, disabled or expired). Check it in [Settings](/admin/settings), then run the search again.
coversBusy: RAWG asks you to wait (too many requests). Try again in an hour or two.
coversDown: RAWG cannot be reached right now. Nothing was changed: try again later.
coversDone: Search finished: {found} cover(s) found, {none} with no result on RAWG.
coversMore: {left} left to try: run the search again.
